subject.title: fix(message): ignore populated location on text sends

question: Should the shared `message` API silently prefer text/media over a valid location payload, or should it retain the mixed-payload rejection and fix the generator that emits the unwanted location?
rationale: The runner receives only a valid location object and other content, so it has no reliable signal for whether coordinates were incidental model output or deliberately requested user content.

options.title: Preserve explicit location intent
options.body: Keep the runner's mixed-payload validation and correct the caller or generator that spuriously populates location.

options.title: Adopt text/media precedence
options.body: Accept that mixed sends will silently omit coordinates and document this as the permanent message-tool contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve explicit location intent
recommendation.body: Keep the runner's mixed-payload validation and correct the caller or generator that spuriously populates location.

likelyOwner.reason: A current outbound-message owner needs to choose the durable API semantics because the branch changes behavior for all channel adapters.
